About Me

My name is Abigail and I’m an artist and graphic designer from Lincoln, Nebraska. As a creative, I know what it truly means to be passionate about a project. Whether I’m creating something that authentically represents a client, or diving into learning a new artistic skill, my enthusiasm to create is limitless!

I’m highly proficient in Adobe programs like Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, and also have experience with web design and animation. I love to combine clean, minimalist visuals with illustrative elements and bold textures. Making something that represents a concept effectively while simultaneously catching eyes is my ultimate goal!

If you’d like to get in touch with me, visit my Contact page!
